name: Ava Jager
bio:
Ava Jager is a English-Dutch actress.

Her credits include Masters of the Air (2025) and Narnia (2026).

She trains at Sylvia Young Theatre School and has achieved Distinction in all LAMDA exams up to Gold. Awarded performing arts scholarships at her current and next schools, she is also skilled in boxing, gymnastics, and singing.

credits.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
credits.overview: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.
